en.hubeali: From him, from a number of our companions, raising it, saying,
‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘For everything there is a cure, and a cure for the sins is the seeking of Forgiveness’.
en.sarwar: 8. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from a number of our people in a marfu’ manner from him (a.s.) who has said the following: “
For everything there is a medicine and the medicine for sins is pleading (before Allah) for forgiveness.”
